supplemental_items.interpretation: Target icon is actual full-history candle at source index+49, not an extrapolated time or a visible-end-clamped candle. Target lookup uses only upper bound. Direction defaults bullish if attribute absent; exact bullish selects ph fields, previous bearish and icon High, all other values select pl/previous bullish/Low. Absolute source and icon indexes add market offset; prices are stringified, not rounded.
supplemental_items.conditional_boundary: No empirical runtime or cross-owner acceptance asserted.
